name: Reconya
description: Reconya is a network reconnaissance and asset discovery tool. It sweeps your networks with ICMP, ARP and TCP probes, identifies devices and their open ports, and alerts on new devices or risky ports, all in a web console with a topology map.

notes.text: Log in as admin with the generated LOGIN_PASSWORD from /opt/reconya_data/.env. To change it, edit that file and run systemctl restart reconya.
Sessions are signed with a key built into the binary, so a session cookie from any Reconya install works on yours. Keep port 3008 on a trusted network, never on the internet.
Nothing is scanned until you add a network under Networks and start a scan. ARP and MAC discovery only reach the bridges or VLANs the container has an interface on.
